name: @some-ui/wasm-loader
description: Generic, zero-runtime-dependency wasm module load/init/singleton primitive. Ships as plain TypeScript source (no bundler-specific build) so it can be path-imported by packages/* and extensions/* alike - see packages/README.md and extensions/common/GOOD_CITIZEN.md's Class-A shared-import doctrine.

scripts.clean: rimraf .turbo && rimraf node_modules && rimraf .eslintcache && rimraf tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:js && pnpm prettier && pnpm typecheck
